name: Sandbox Link
description: Live link per channel: spins up a Vercel Sandbox dev server for a branch of your reflect-orbital checkout and pins the link above the composer.

args: source ~/.zshrc >/dev/null 2>&1; R="${1:-$HOME/.buzz/REPOS/reflect-orbital}"; shift; R="${R/#\~/$HOME}"; fail() { echo "$1" >&2; printf '{"state":"error","error":"%s"}\n' "$1"; exit $2; }; cd "$R" 2>/dev/null || fail "Folder not found: $R" 3; [ -f scripts/sandbox/link.mjs ] || fail "No scripts/sandbox/link.mjs in $R. Pull main and run pnpm install." 4; command -v node >/dev/null || fail "node not found on PATH" 5; exec node scripts/sandbox/link.mjs "$@"
